verdict.rationale: First-party docs explicitly claim container tools are usable with no setup and access to the Red Hat registry, directly matching the story, but this is vendor marketing text with no independent/hands-on corroboration or technical detail (e.g., podman defaults, rootless setup). Missing for 10: independent verification that container tools work out-of-the-box, detail on which tools are preinstalled vs require configuration, and any community confirmation or contradiction.
